title: Option to sort wallpapers
line: The wallpaper list in Desktop and Wallpaper settings has a Sort menu that can show the newest wallpapers first instead of only A to Z.
explanation: The Image wallpaper's list was always sorted alphabetically by a fixed KSortFilterProxyModel in ThumbnailsComponent.qml, and the models exposed no date to sort by, so a freshly downloaded or added wallpaper ended up somewhere in a long list. The image and package list models now expose a "modified" role (the file's or package folder's modification time), and the Images header gets a Sort menu with "A to Z" and "Date modified (newest first)", the same wording as the slideshow's Order box. Changing the order re-selects the current wallpaper and scrolls the list to the top.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: add a sort menu to the wallpaper list

The image wallpaper list was always sorted by name, so a wallpaper that
was just downloaded or added could end up anywhere in a long list. Add a
Sort menu to the list's header to also sort it by newest modified first.

BUG: 419074

patches.diff:
From a03e6be98aedca5375ee68fd0f3858f2428bc5a1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 19:06:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] wallpapers/image: add a sort menu to the wallpaper list

The image wallpaper list was always sorted by name, so a wallpaper that
was just downloaded or added could end up anywhere in a long list. Add a
Sort menu to the list's header to also sort it by newest modified first.

BUG: 419074
---
 .../contents/ui/ThumbnailsComponent.qml       | 35 ++++++++++++++++++-
 .../plugin/model/abstractimagelistmodel.cpp   |  1 +
 .../image/plugin/model/imagelistmodel.cpp     |  3 ++
 wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imageroles.h    |  1 +
 .../image/plugin/model/packagelistmodel.cpp   |  3 ++
 5 files changed, 42 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/ThumbnailsComponent.qml b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/ThumbnailsComponent.qml
index 730686fd57..babb1ec9e9 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/ThumbnailsComponent.qml
+++ b/wallpapers/image/imagepackage/contents/ui/ThumbnailsComponent.qml
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@
 */
 
 import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Controls as QQC2
 import QtQuick.Layouts
 
 import org.kde.kcmutils as KCM
@@ -20,13 +21,15 @@ Item {
 
     property alias view: wallpapersGrid.view
     property var screenSize: Qt.size(Screen.width, Screen.height)
+    property bool sortByModified: false
 
 
     readonly property QtObject imageModel: (configDialog.currentWallpaper === "org.kde.image") ? sortedWallpaperModel : imageWallpaper.slideFilterModel
 
     KItemModels.KSortFilterProxyModel  {
         id: sortedWallpaperModel
-        sortRole: Qt.DisplayRole
+        sortRoleName: thumbnailsComponent.sortByModified ? "modified" : "display"
+        sortOrder: thumbnailsComponent.sortByModified ? Qt.DescendingOrder : Qt.AscendingOrder
         sortCaseSensitivity: Qt.CaseInsensitive
         sortColumn: 0
         sourceModel: (configDialog.currentWallpaper === "org.kde.image") ? imageWallpaper.wallpaperModel : null
@@ -51,6 +54,16 @@ Item {
     }
 
 
+    QQC2.ActionGroup {
+        id: sortGroup
+    }
+
+    function setSortByModified(sortByModified: bool): void {
+        thumbnailsComponent.sortByModified = sortByModified;
+        wallpapersGrid.resetCurrentIndex();
+        wallpapersGrid.view.positionViewAtIndex(0, GridView.Beginning);
+    }
+
     Connections {
         target: imageWallpaper
         function onLoadingChanged(loading: bool) {
@@ -94,6 +107,26 @@ Item {
                     visible: configDialog.currentWallpaper == "org.kde.image"
                     onTriggered: root.openChooserDialog();
                 },
+                Kirigami.Action {
+                    icon.name: "view-sort-symbolic"
+                    text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@action:button sort the list of wallpapers", "Sort")
+                    visible: configDialog.currentWallpaper == "org.kde.image"
+
+                    Kirigami.Action {
+                        text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "A to Z")
+                        checkable: true
+                        QQC2.ActionGroup.group: sortGroup
+                        checked: !thumbnailsComponent.sortByModified
+                        onTriggered: thumbnailsComponent.setSortByModified(false)
+                    }
+                    Kirigami.Action {
+                        text: i18nd("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "Date modified (newest first)")
+                        checkable: true
+                        QQC2.ActionGroup.group: sortGroup
+                        checked: thumbnailsComponent.sortByModified
+                        onTriggered: thumbnailsComponent.setSortByModified(true)
+                    }
+                },
                 NewStuff.Action {
                     configFile: Kirigami.Settings.isMobile ? "wallpaper-mobile.knsrc" : "wallpaper.knsrc"
                     text: i18ndc("plasma_wallpaper_org.kde.image", "@action:button the new things being gotten are wallpapers", "Get New…")
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/abstractimagelistmodel.cpp b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/abstractimagelistmodel.cpp
index 5839136e39..6a1e4f90d3 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/abstractimagelistmodel.cpp
+++ b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/abstractimagelistmodel.cpp
@@ -33,6 +33,7 @@ QHash<int, QByteArray> AbstractImageListModel::roleNames() const
         {PendingDeletionRole, QByteArrayLiteral("pendingDeletion")},
         {ToggleRole, QByteArrayLiteral("checked")},
         {SelectorsRole, QByteArrayLiteral("selectors")},
+        {ModifiedRole, QByteArrayLiteral("modified")},
     };
 }
 
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imagelistmodel.cpp b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imagelistmodel.cpp
index 694d1e0992..a41030f265 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imagelistmodel.cpp
+++ b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imagelistmodel.cpp
@@ -81,6 +81,9 @@ QVariant ImageListModel::data(const QModelIndex &index, int role) const
 
     case SelectorsRole:
         return QStringList();
+
+    case ModifiedRole:
+        return QFileInfo(m_data.at(row)).lastModified();
     }
     Q_UNREACHABLE();
 }
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imageroles.h b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imageroles.h
index 5924b7bef5..695e6fc33a 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imageroles.h
+++ b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/imageroles.h
@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@ public:
         PendingDeletionRole,
         ToggleRole, /**< Used in slideshow model */
         SelectorsRole,
+        ModifiedRole,
     };
     Q_ENUM(RoleType)
 };
diff --git a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/packagelistmodel.cpp b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/packagelistmodel.cpp
index 632f1ae8fe..5c9c962c2c 100644
--- a/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/packagelistmodel.cpp
+++ b/wallpapers/image/plugin/model/packagelistmodel.cpp
@@ -79,6 +79,9 @@ QVariant PackageListModel::data(const QModelIndex &index, int role) const
 
     case SelectorsRole:
         return b.selectors();
+
+    case ModifiedRole:
+        return QFileInfo(b.package().path()).lastModified();
     }
     Q_UNREACHABLE();
 }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: the Images header has no sort option; the list is always A to Z.
Master: a just-added wallpaper ("Zucchini Fresh Download") sits at the very bottom of the list.
With the fix: a Sort menu in the Images header with "A to Z" and "Date modified (newest first)".
Newest first: the just-added wallpaper is now the first item.
